plugins.name: council
plugins.description: Multi-agent LLM council for code: diverse finder lenses, blind anonymized cross-examination with refute-first skeptics, and an execution-based evidence tribunal. Surface-first — reports findings with execution proof plus a plain-English + technical fix and operator context; the operator directs which findings to fix. Review, debug, and goal-audit modes.
